# Agentic Workspaces

> Persistent, provider-neutral memory for AI agents: one git repo of markdown
> files that outlives every conversation. Conventions, templates, and ~1,500
> lines of dependency-free Python. The durable asset in agentic work is not
> the agent, it's the state.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/rdmayo21/agentic-workspaces/blob/main/README.md): core ideas, quickstart, what's verified, design rules worth stealing
- [Workspace conventions](https://github.com/rdmayo21/agentic-workspaces/blob/main/skills/new-ai-workspace/references/workspace-conventions.md): the full file grammar and update discipline
- [System skill](https://github.com/rdmayo21/agentic-workspaces/blob/main/skills/new-ai-workspace/SKILL.md): how agents operate the system
- [Examples](https://github.com/rdmayo21/agentic-workspaces/tree/main/examples): a filled-in workspace and its project skill

## Key ideas

- Files over conversations: any session can be killed without losing state
- Provider-neutral: Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI read the same files
- Append-only decision logs with rationale; pre-registered experiments
- Four certainty levels: confirmed / decided / tentative / unreviewed idea
- One home per fact; archive, don't delete; re-verify anything stale
